blocks.text: Predicate logic studies statements that contain variables and predicates. A predicate is a statement that can be true or false depending on the values of the variables. For example, “x is greater than 5” is a predicate because it depends on x. Predicate logic allows expressing statements like “All students are hardworking” or “Some books are interesting.” It is used to represent knowledge formally.
